report:
Skin, back, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the reticular dermis. The dermis shows thickened hyalinised collagen bundles and loss of periadnexal fat. The biopsy has squared-off edges. There is a mild superficial and deep perivascular infiltrate of lymphocytes and plasma cells. The overall features are those of dermal sclerosis, in keeping with morphoea. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, back, punch biopsy - DERMAL SCLEROSIS, in keeping with MORPHOEA
